script:
import json, os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
case = sys.argv[1]
assert case in ["default", "notify", "foreground"]
out = Path(__file__).with_name(case + "-events.jsonl")
start = time.monotonic()
def emit(event):
    row = {"case": case, "event": event, "wall_time": time.time(), "elapsed_s": round(time.monotonic() - start, 3), "pid": os.getpid()}
    with out.open("a") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
emit("PROBE_START")
time.sleep(45)
emit("PROBE_DONE")
